GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.112 (18 Feb 46) GS
(SCAPIN - 754)
APO 500
18 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Archives and Property in Canada.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O.563 (5.1), dated 6 February 1946, on the above subject.
2. This Headquarters has no objection to the completion of the transfer of custody of Japanese diplomatic and consular archives and property I Canada from the Swiss representatives in Canada to the Canadian Property Custodian, ad suggested in the Swiss Legation's note number ZZ.1.1. - GDb of 31 January 1946.
3. The Japanese Government will accordingly deliver to this Headquarters a note addressed to the Swiss Legation requesting that the Swiss representatives in Canada be instructed to transfer custody of the Japanese archives and property in Canada either to the Canadian Custodian or to the American Ambassador to Canada, whichever the allied representatives in Canada may elect.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
